label: Akoya
description: US consumer-permissioned data access network that connects data recipients (fintechs, aggregators) to financial institutions through FDX-standard APIs instead of screen scraping. Founded in 2020 out of Fidelity Investments, with The Clearing House and large US banks as owners. Institutions connect directly (e.g. Chase, Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, PNC, Fidelity) or through their core providers (Fiserv, Jack Henry, FIS).
